verdict.rationale: Chronicle's authentication docs describe scoped API keys and recommend giving the agent process a narrower key (agents:write, traces:write) than a CI key (platform). This is first-party least-privilege credentialing for an agent, but it rests on a single brief mention. Missing for 10: documentation of how keys are issued and scopes selected, the full scope catalog, expiry/rotation/revocation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: A key supplied to your agent process typically has agents:write and traces:write.
